verdict.rationale: Firebase's Local Emulator Suite explicitly supports running Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Storage, Authentication, Hosting, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, and Extensions locally, and it integrates with the firebase-tools CLI for local hosting, data interaction, and deployment—together covering a full local backend stack for testing before deploy. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the emulator suite's completeness or reliability beyond official docs.
